newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Somague to distribute 20 pct 1996 net.
newsitem.headline: Somague to distribute 20 pct 1996 net.

text.p: Portuguese construction group Somague SGPS expects to distribute as dividends 20 percent of its estimated 1996 net consolidated profit of one billion escudos, its vice-president Diogo Vaz Guedes said.
"The payout should be slightly above 20 percent, giving about 22 escudos in gross dividend per share," he told Reuters.
Somague last paid a net dividend of 16 escudos per share in 1993.
Somague shares closed at 1,945 escudos, up 139, in volume of 67,900 shares. The shares hit a 1997 high of 1,950 escudos today.
